title: Nell and the Sap
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 3 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds l, ll, ss
note_for_grown_ups: A true fact tucked into a tiny-word-pool book: sap really does collect in a pot when it drips from a tree, and it really is very sticky!

pages.text: Sap. Sap is in a pot.
pages.illustration: A small wooden pot under a tree trunk, collecting drips of amber sap from a tap in the bark.
Nell the bee landing and sitting on the rim of the pot of amber sap.
Nell the bee dozing on the rim of the pot, close to the sticky sap.
Nell the bee slipping down into the amber sap inside the pot, startled.
Pip the sparrow leaning over the pot, tapping gently at Nell to help pull her free of the sticky sap.
Close view of Pip's beak nipping carefully at the sticky strands of sap holding Nell.

pages.text: Nell is not in sap! Nell is not sad.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee free on the rim of the pot, smiling, a little sap on her legs, Pip the sparrow watching kindly.
